study.title: OEDRO Light Research
study.goal: Test whether a controlled-autonomy AI interviewer can understand vehicle-lighting experiences, repair conversation breakdowns, and preserve auditable evidence without work-light-specific runtime code.
decisionQuestions: Which real use situations and visibility problems deserve further product research?
Which concept, installation, or price concerns need stronger evidence?

audience.description: Synthetic adult vehicle-owner personas used only for local acceptance testing.
eligibility: Can describe a real lighting situation

claims.text: The synthetic concept includes example size and price tiers from 7–8 inches at $129.99 to 48–52 inches at $499.99.
claims.source: Synthetic research configuration fixture; sample concepts and price tiers for internal testing.

en.title: Review how this synthetic test uses your answers
en.intro: This optional screen is dormant unless a specific project explicitly enables it.
items: Written answers are stored in the local test database and processed by the configured AI provider.
Do not enter names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, or other contact details.
en.checkbox: I understand and want to start this synthetic study.

dataPolicy.providerDisclosure: Answers are processed by a configured third-party AI provider for interview understanding, controlled follow-up, and evidence extraction.

fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer as stated or cautiously normalized
Vehicle model as stated or kept as a candidate
Broad setting only; never precise location or identifying address.
What was difficult to see or do
What the participant did in response
First reaction to the synthetic concept

Explicit response about the listed synthetic tiers: small_129, medium_279, large_499, none (explicitly considers none of these tiers), or not_sure (explicitly undecided). Missing, skipped, refused, or unrelated answers do not establish any price_fit. none does not by itself mean no product need; keep the participant's stated reason separately in price_reason.
Reason the price feels acceptable or unacceptable

anchors.label: Use context
anchors.objective: Identify the participant's vehicle and ordinary after-dark use without demanding details that do not change the research path.
anchors.question: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?

questionLocales.en: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 你天黑后通常用车做什么？
questionLocales.es: ¿Para qué usas normalmente tu vehículo después de anochecer?

anchors.clarification: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?

clarificationLocales.en: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 你天黑后通常用车做什么？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Para qué usas normalmente tu vehículo después de anochecer?

sufficiencyCriteria: Vehicle model or a usable candidate is recorded
highValueProbeTargets: Vehicle identity only when it changes fitment or interpretation

placeholder.en: A brief real example is enough…
placeholder.zh-CN: 简短说清车辆和用途就可以…
placeholder.es: Un ejemplo real y breve es suficiente…

vehicle_year.en: What model year is your vehicle?
vehicle_year.zh-CN: 你的车是哪一年的款式？

use_context.en: How do you usually use your vehicle after dark?
use_context.zh-CN: 你天黑后通常用车做什么？
use_context.es: ¿Para qué usas normalmente tu vehículo después de anochecer?

anchors.label: Recent experience
anchors.objective: Capture a concrete recent low-light situation and the visibility problem without treating short answers as poor answers.
anchors.question: How was visibility the last time you used your vehicle after dark?

questionLocales.en: How was visibility the last time you used your vehicle after dark?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 最近一次天黑后用车时，视野怎么样？
questionLocales.es: ¿Cómo fue la visibilidad la última vez que usaste tu vehículo de noche?

anchors.clarification: What, if anything, was difficult to see?

clarificationLocales.en: What, if anything, was difficult to see?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 当时有没有什么看不清的地方？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Qué te resultó difícil de ver, si hubo algo?

sufficiencyCriteria: A real location or situation is present
The visibility problem or affected task is understood

placeholder.en: Describe the place and what was difficult to see…
placeholder.zh-CN: 说说地点和当时最难看清的东西…
placeholder.es: Describe el lugar y qué era difícil ver…

recent_location.en: What kind of setting was it? A broad description is enough.
recent_location.zh-CN: 当时是在什么样的环境里？大致描述就可以。
recent_location.es: ¿Qué tipo de entorno era? Basta con una descripción general.

visibility_problem.en: What, if anything, was difficult to see?
visibility_problem.zh-CN: 当时有没有什么看不清的地方？
visibility_problem.es: ¿Qué te resultó difícil de ver, si hubo algo?

user_action.en: What did you do at that point, if anything?
user_action.zh-CN: 当时你有没有采取什么行动？
user_action.es: ¿Qué hiciste en ese momento, si hiciste algo?

anchors.label: Priorities
anchors.objective: Identify the most important lighting outcomes for comparison across participants.
anchors.question: Which outcomes matter most for your lighting setup?

questionLocales.en: Which outcomes matter most for your lighting setup?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 你的照明设置最看重哪些效果？
questionLocales.es: ¿Qué resultados le importan más en su configuración de iluminación?

anchors.clarification: I am asking which results matter most when you judge a lighting setup.

clarificationLocales.en: I want to confirm the most important result for you. Which result matters most?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我想确认对你最重要的照明结果。哪一项最重要？
clarificationLocales.es: Quiero confirmar el resultado más importante para usted. ¿Cuál importa más?

sufficiencyCriteria: At least one priority is selected or stated
highValueProbeTargets: A reason only when priorities conflict

priority.en: What matters most to you about your current lighting?
priority.zh-CN: 对于现在的照明，你最在意什么？
priority.es: ¿Qué es lo que más te importa de tu iluminación actual?

anchors.label: Constraints
anchors.objective: Find practical barriers that could block installation, ownership, or legal use.
anchors.question: What would affect your decision about using auxiliary lights?

questionLocales.en: What would affect your decision about using auxiliary lights?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 什么会影响你是否使用辅助灯的决定？
questionLocales.es: ¿Qué influiría en tu decisión de usar luces auxiliares?

anchors.clarification: What would affect your decision about using auxiliary lights?

clarificationLocales.en: What would affect your decision about using auxiliary lights?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 什么会影响你是否使用辅助灯的决定？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Qué influiría en tu decisión de usar luces auxiliares?

sufficiencyCriteria: One practical constraint is recorded, or the participant says none comes to mind
highValueProbeTargets: A concrete barrier that changes product requirements

placeholder.en: You may skip if nothing comes to mind…
placeholder.es: Puedes omitirla si no se te ocurre nada…

constraint.en: What would affect your decision about using auxiliary lights?
constraint.zh-CN: 什么会影响你是否使用辅助灯的决定？
constraint.es: ¿Qué influiría en tu decisión de usar luces auxiliares?

anchors.label: Concept
anchors.objective: Record the participant's spontaneous concept reaction before detailed price interpretation.
anchors.question: What is your first honest reaction to this configurable auxiliary-light concept?

questionLocales.en: What is your first honest reaction to this configurable auxiliary-light concept?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 你对这个可配置辅助灯概念的第一真实反应是什么？
questionLocales.es: ¿Cuál es su primera reacción sincera a este concepto de luz auxiliar configurable?

anchors.clarification: I want your first reaction to the idea shown here, including what feels useful or concerning.

clarificationLocales.en: I want to understand your most direct reaction to the idea. What stands out most?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我想确认你对这个想法最直接的感受。最突出的一点是什么？
clarificationLocales.es: Quiero entender su reacción más directa a la idea. ¿Qué aspecto destaca más?

sufficiencyCriteria: A spontaneous reaction, value, or concern is recorded
highValueProbeTargets: A specific concern that changes the concept

alt.en: Placeholder for an approved product concept image
alt.zh-CN: 待批准产品概念图占位
alt.es: Marcador para una imagen aprobada del concepto

placeholder.en: React to the idea, not the placeholder artwork…
placeholder.zh-CN: 请评价产品想法，不用评价占位图…
placeholder.es: Comenta la idea, no el marcador de imagen…

concept_reaction.en: What stands out to you about the concept? It is fine if the material is not enough to judge.
concept_reaction.zh-CN: 这个概念让你最在意的是什么？资料不足以判断也可以直接说。
concept_reaction.es: ¿Qué te llama la atención del concepto? Está bien si el material no basta para valorarlo.

anchors.label: Price
anchors.objective: Record a considered synthetic tier, an explicit decision to consider none of the tiers, or explicit uncertainty. Preserve the stated reason without inferring that rejecting these tiers always means no product need.
anchors.question: Which of these sample tiers, if any, would you consider?

questionLocales.en: Which of these sample tiers, if any, would you consider?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 这些模拟档位中，有没有你会考虑的？
questionLocales.es: ¿Cuál de estos niveles de ejemplo considerarías, si alguno?

anchors.clarification: What led you to that choice, including choosing none?

clarificationLocales.en: What led you to that choice, including choosing none?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 是什么让你做出这个选择，包括一个都不选？
clarificationLocales.es: ¿Qué te llevó a esa elección, incluida la de no elegir ninguno?

sufficiencyCriteria: Record the declared option ID matching the explicit answer: small_129, medium_279, large_499, none, or not_sure.

Explicitly considering no listed tier is none; explicitly being undecided is not_sure. Neither requires choosing a price tier. A missing, skipped, refused, or unrelated answer is not none or not_sure.
Keep any stated reason in price_reason; do not invent no purchase need, a budget problem, or a selected tier.
highValueProbeTargets: What makes a selected tier feel worth or not worth its price

price_fit.en: Which of these sample tiers, if any, would you consider?
price_fit.zh-CN: 这些模拟档位中，有没有你会考虑的？
price_fit.es: ¿Cuál de estos niveles de ejemplo considerarías, si alguno?

price_reason.en: What led you to that choice, including choosing none?
price_reason.zh-CN: 是什么让你做出这个选择，包括一个都不选？
price_reason.es: ¿Qué te llevó a esa elección, incluida la de no elegir ninguno?

anchors.label: Final change
anchors.objective: Force a final priority choice that can inform the next research or concept iteration.
anchors.question: What, if anything, would you change first?

questionLocales.en: What, if anything, would you change first?
questionLocales.zh-CN: 如果要改，你最想先改什么？不需要改也可以。

anchors.clarification: I am asking for the single change that would matter most to you.

clarificationLocales.en: I want to confirm the single highest-priority change. What should change first?
clarificationLocales.zh-CN: 我想确认最优先的一项改动。你最希望先改什么？
clarificationLocales.es: Quiero confirmar el cambio de mayor prioridad. ¿Qué debería cambiar primero?

highValueProbeTargets: Why this change outranks alternatives, only if unclear

placeholder.zh-CN: 只选一个最重要的变化…

final_change.en: What, if anything, would you change first?
final_change.zh-CN: 如果要改，你最想先改什么？不需要改也可以。

messages.en: Your synthetic interview record is complete. No reward or follow-up is attached to this fixture.
messages.zh-CN: 这次模拟访谈已经完成，不会触发奖励或后续联系。
messages.es: Tu registro sintético está completo. Esta prueba no incluye recompensa ni seguimiento.
